description:
OptionParser.parse/2 in fz, as in Elixir 1.19.4 (approved page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.16.html). Distill line 13: OptionParser.parse(args, strict: [top: :integer]) -> {opts, argv, invalid}.

Surface: strict: and aliases:; :boolean, :integer, :float, :string, :count, each with :keep; --name value, --name=value, --no-name, kebab-case, alias clusters, --, lone -. Strict lookup compares text, creating no atoms; an unknown name never consumes the next token. Adds Integer.parse/1 (fz; past 64 bits it fails loudly, documented) and Float.parse/1 (one runtime helper). The rest of the surface is fz-sc8.58.
